subject: Mathematics
title: Application of Derivatives
summary: Derivatives se rate of change, tangent aur normal ke slopes milte hain, aur pata chalta hai ki function kahan increasing, decreasing hai ya kahan maxima aur minima hain.
First-derivative test (f′ ka sign change) aur second-derivative test (f″ ka sign) local extrema dhoondhte hain; [a, b] par absolute extrema critical points aur end points mein se hi hote hain.
Rolle's theorem aur mean value theorem average aur instantaneous rates ko jodte hain. Optimisation word problems — areas, volumes, distances — standard JEE sawal hain.

formulas.name: Rate of change
formulas.when: Related rates (time ke saath badalta area, volume).

formulas.name: Tangent and normal
formulas.formula: tangent: y − y₁ = m(x − x₁), m = f′(x₁);  normal: y − y₁ = −(1/m)(x − x₁)

formulas.name: Increasing / decreasing
formulas.formula: f′(x) > 0 ⇒ strictly increasing;  f′(x) < 0 ⇒ strictly decreasing
formulas.mistake: Isolated points par f′ = 0 ho sakta hai phir bhi f increasing (x³ at 0) — ise decreasing mat samjho.

formulas.name: Critical points
formulas.formula: f′(c) = 0 or f′(c) does not exist

formulas.name: First-derivative test
formulas.formula: f′ changes + to − ⇒ local maximum;  − to + ⇒ local minimum;  no change ⇒ neither (point of inflection)

formulas.name: Second-derivative test
formulas.formula: f′(c) = 0 and f″(c) < 0 ⇒ local max;  f″(c) > 0 ⇒ local min;  f″(c) = 0 ⇒ test fails

formulas.name: Absolute extrema on [a, b]
formulas.formula: compare f at all critical points in (a, b) and at a, b

formulas.name: Rolle's theorem
formulas.formula: f continuous on [a, b], differentiable on (a, b), f(a) = f(b) ⇒ ∃ c ∈ (a, b): f′(c) = 0

formulas.name: Lagrange's mean value theorem
formulas.formula: f′(c) = (f(b) − f(a))/(b − a) for some c ∈ (a, b)
formulas.when: Average rate = kahin na kahin instantaneous rate.

formulas.name: Standard optimisation results
formulas.formula: fixed perimeter → square has max area;  fixed surface area → cube (or sphere) has max volume;  cylinder of max volume in a sphere: h = 2R/√3

formulas.name: Angle between curves
formulas.formula: tan θ = |(m₁ − m₂)/(1 + m₁m₂)| using slopes of tangents at the intersection;  orthogonal if m₁m₂ = −1
formulas.when: Ek doosre ko kaatne wali curves.

examples.title: Local extrema
examples.problem: f(x) = x³ − 3x² − 9x + 5 ki local maximum aur minimum values nikalo.

examples.title: Related rates
examples.problem: Ek sphere ka radius 0.1 cm/s se badhta hai. r = 5 cm par volume kitni tezi se badh raha hai?

examples.title: Maximum area
examples.problem: Perimeter 20 wale rectangle ka maximum area?

examples.title: Mean value theorem
examples.problem: [1, 3] par f(x) = x² ke liye c nikalo.

examples.title: Increasing interval
examples.solution: f′ = 3(x² − 1) > 0 ⇒ x < −1 ya x > 1: (−∞, −1) ∪ (1, ∞) par increasing.

topics.title: Monotonicity and inequalities
topics.explain: x > 0 ke liye f(x) > g(x) saabit karne ke liye dikhao ki h = f − g mein h(0) = 0 aur h′ > 0. Example: x ≠ 0 ke liye eˣ > 1 + x.

topics.title: Points of inflection
topics.explain: Jahan f″ ka sign badalta hai (concavity badalti hai). f″ > 0 par f concave up aur f″ < 0 par concave down.

topics.title: Optimisation steps
topics.explain: Constraint se optimise karne wali quantity ko ek variable mein likho, critical points nikalo, test karo, aur endpoints/domain restrictions check karo.

topics.title: Shortest distance problems
topics.explain: Distance ki jagah distance ka square minimise karo — minimiser wahi, algebra aasaan.

topics.title: Tangents from an external point
topics.explain: General point (t, f(t)) par tangent likho aur use diye point se guzaaro; t ke liye solve karo.

ratta: Fixed perimeter → square;  fixed surface → cube.
